application.stem: An ideal projectile is launched and later lands at the same height with u_x=12 m/s, u_y=16 m/s and g=8 m/s^2. Find the total flight time, range and landing velocity.
conditions: Launch and landing heights are equal.

reasoning_route.action: Represent landing at the launch height with Delta y=0 while keeping a_x=0, a_y=-g and one common flight time.
reasoning_route.why_valid: Same launch and landing height fixes the vertical event displacement without changing the gravity-only component model.
reasoning_route.output: The landing event satisfies 0=16t-4t^2 and horizontal motion shares that time.

reasoning_route.action: Choose the nonzero root of the vertical event equation as the landing time and reject t=0 as the launch event.
reasoning_route.why_valid: The equation describes two visits to the launch height; event identity selects the later root because the question asks for landing.
reasoning_route.output: The total flight time is 4 s.

reasoning_route.action: Reuse t=4 s in horizontal displacement and vertical velocity to obtain range and landing velocity.
reasoning_route.why_valid: Range and landing velocity belong to the same landing event identified by the vertical equation.
reasoning_route.output: Range=48 m and landing velocity=(12i-16j) m/s.

reasoning_route.action: Compare launch and landing components: v_x must match while v_y has equal magnitude and opposite sign.
reasoning_route.why_valid: With zero horizontal acceleration and constant downward gravity, return to the same height restores vertical speed magnitude while reversing its direction.
reasoning_route.output: v_x=12 m/s at both events and v_y changes from +16 to -16 m/s.

hints.text: What vertical displacement condition is true at a same-height landing?
Use Delta y=0 to obtain the nonzero landing time, then reuse that time in x and v_y.

scaffolds.text: Write the landing geometry first: identify Delta y when the projectile returns to its launch height.
The vertical equation has a launch root and a later root; identify which event is requested before reusing the time.

application.check: At the same height, the horizontal component matches launch and the vertical component has equal magnitude with opposite sign.

solution.summary: The flight time is 4 s, the range is 48 m, and the landing velocity is (12 i - 16 j) m/s.
steps: At landing Delta y=0=16t-0.5(8)t^2; the nonzero root is t=4 s.
Horizontal velocity stays 12 m/s, so range=12(4)=48 m.

repair.action: For a return to the launch height, set Delta y=0 and treat any same-height flight-time/range shortcut as conditional on that equality.
repair.why_valid: The shortcut follows from the vertical displacement returning to its initial value; it is not valid when the landing height differs.
repair.output: same-height event condition and its validity boundary
